sources.title: ワザップ! — BLACK/MATRIX 00 エンディング分岐Q&A
sources.notes: PRIMARY JAPANESE SET B supplementary component. Directly inspectable community Q&A. Independently corroborates the four ordinary ending outcomes, bonus scenario 11 at 第7章 自由行動3, its prerequisites (bonus scenarios 4 and 9), and the ending-affecting ring. It explicitly does not know the second-playthrough ending condition, so use the FC2 ending page for that detail.

disagreements: Research is still blocked before route generation, but the Set-B situation is materially improved. First, the earlier scaffold had bonus scenario 1 おつかい in chapter 3 because the 2020 TSST memo labels it ＜3章＞. That conflicts with the contemporaneous Set A play diary, which reaches おつかい before its explicit ～第3章～ entry, and with the directly inspected Set B FC2 chapter-2 walkthrough, which places it at 第2章 自由行動2; the detailed FFSKY supplemental walkthrough agrees with chapter 2. The master-order scaffold has therefore been corrected to chapter 2 and the TSST chapter label is recorded as a source disagreement. Second, indexed FC2 child pages are directly inspectable even though the hub/intermittent chapter fetches can 403: chapter 2, chapter 5, chapter 8, and the ending page now provide substantial independent Japanese Set-B coverage, while Wazap independently corroborates bonus scenario 11 timing/prerequisites and its ending-affecting ring. The FC2 ending page also shows that practical 100% cleanup must include six endings, including the second-playthrough best ending and サーカスED. Remaining blocker: independently inspect or replace the still-inaccessible FC2 chapter pages (especially chapters 3, 4, 6, 7, and 9) so every 100%-critical bonus-scenario window/prerequisite and ending-affecting progression fact has direct Set-B support. Do not generate route_*.json until that coverage is closed.
